messages.subject: Calverton Industries — representations & remediation (HSE ref WM/SAN/2026/0488)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitlow,

Further to the Improvement Notice of 2 April, please find attached our letter of representations and the Company's executed Remediation and Improvement Plan. The Company accepts the substance of the Notice and does not intend to appeal it. It has taken all four Excelon cells out of service, brought the interlock keys under controlled issue, and instructed the OEM to retrofit trapped-key interlocks with dual-channel monitoring.

We should be glad to meet to walk you through the remediation. Please direct further document or interview requests to this firm.

Sarah Whitfield

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Strictly private and confidential.

messages.subject: RE: Calverton Industries — representations & remediation (HSE ref WM/SAN/2026/0488)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Thank you. I acknowledge the representations and the remediation plan, and I note the cells are out of service. The investigation remains open and a decision on enforcement has not yet been taken. I would welcome the offered progress meeting; please propose dates in the week of 11 May. I will also need the completed training and PUWER reassessment records when available.

Karen Whitlow
HM Inspector of Health and Safety
